FOOTER.ABOUT_TEXT: La Dolce Vita is a car rental company that provides its customers with a vast fleet of cars, complete with vehicles suitable for any need, divided into different categories and price ranges. From city cars to SUVs, from minivans to vans, whatever your transportation needs, La Dolce Vita car rental proposes tailor-made solutions from every point of view.

autonoleggio.INTRO_TEXT: La Dolce Vita is the reference car rental agency in Mottola and in the province of Taranto, an attentive and professional company capable of responding to any customer request with the utmost accuracy. Having a large fleet of cars, the company manages to meet different needs by proposing vehicles suitable for individual travelers and families, tourist groups, and businesses, always guaranteeing the highest quality standards of the service. There is also no shortage of short-term rental cars, from the most classic models to sports and luxury cars, ideal for making your most important moments even more unforgettable.
autonoleggio.SPLIT_TEXT:
If you wish to rent a short-term car or rather want to have an exclusive vehicle for a gala evening, a bachelorette, or a bachelor party, La Dolce Vita is the right provider to rely on. The car rental company in Mottola, in the province of Taranto, boasts a large fleet of luxury, sports, and classic cars, ready to enhance your character and personality during the most important occasions.

To know the entire fleet of cars for events, do not hesitate to contact the staff on-site and request a detailed quote, tailor-made for you. As part of short-term car rental, La Dolce Vita offers a wide range of both classic models, such as the flagships of the most prestigious car manufacturers, and sports cars. Depending on the style of your event and your personality, you can therefore choose the most suitable type of vehicle and surprise everyone by showing up on board a unique and exclusive vehicle.

veicoli_commerciali.INTRO_TITLE: Short and Long-Term Rental of Cargo Delivery Vans
veicoli_commerciali.INTRO_TEXT: In addition to renting cars of any kind, the La Dolce Vita agency in Mottola also provides van and commercial vehicle rental services, ideal for carrying out rapid and complete goods deliveries. The Taranto car rental company is a partner of numerous corporate entities that have chosen to optimize their costs by taking advantage of the possibility of using a rental vehicle for their business. In this way, in fact, it is possible to cut numerous fixed costs related to the purchase and management of the corporate fleet, while benefiting from tax reliefs for the business activity. Soon, the agency will also add industrial vehicle rental to its services. Commercial vehicles for rent for goods transport, choose the most suitable one for your commercial activity. Vans available for all transport needs: L1 H1 - L1 H2 - L2 H2 - L2 H3 - L3 H3 - L4 H4
veicoli_commerciali.ADVANTAGES_TEXT: Car rental is a particularly advantageous opportunity for companies, as it allows them to have always efficient vehicles without having to bear high costs for their purchase and management. With commercial vehicle rental formulas, it is indeed possible to stipulate short-term contracts on cars, vans, trucks, and any other type of vehicle, under extremely advantageous and flexible conditions.
veicoli_commerciali.PICKUP_TEXT: To meet the needs of its customers, the car rental company La Dolce Vita in Mottola has prepared rental formulas designed for the different needs of applicants. From van rental for commercial activities to executive car rental for businesses, the Taranto company guarantees numerous advantages, such as the possibility of immediate vehicle pickup on-site and online booking: call the office to know all the details of the proposal.

lungo_termine.INTRO_TEXT: La Dolce Vita Car Rental is a company specialized in long-term vehicle rental, offering customized solutions for individuals and businesses. With a wide range of luxury cars, SUVs, sedans, and commercial vehicles, La Dolce Vita stands out for its quality of service and customer care. Each vehicle is maintained in perfect condition, ensuring safety and comfort throughout the duration of the rental.
lungo_termine.ADVANTAGES_TEXT: Long-term rental with La Dolce Vita Car Rental allows customers to enjoy a new car without the concerns related to ownership, such as maintenance, insurance, and vehicle depreciation. With flexible contracts and competitive rates, the company makes the process simple and affordable. Customers can choose the vehicle best suited to their needs and benefit from additional services such as 24/7 roadside assistance and seasonal tire changes.
lungo_termine.INCLUDED_TEXT: La Dolce Vita Car Rental is committed to providing a stress-free rental experience, with dedicated and professional customer service. Their mission is to offer an elegant and practical way to move, allowing customers to focus on their daily activities without having to worry about their means of transportation.

parco_auto.HERO_SUBTITLE: The perfect car for your every need
parco_auto.INTRO_TEXT:
Do you wish to have a new and comfortable car for a longer or shorter period of time?
Are you on holiday in the Taranto area and want to use a vehicle for all your movements?
La Dolce Vita Car Rental is the right operator to turn to for booking a new vehicle in excellent condition at extremely advantageous rates. With a wide and varied offer, the vehicle rental company based in Mottola is ready to satisfy your every need with the utmost attention and professionalism: do not hesitate to call for a quote.

auto_usate.HERO_SUBTITLE: Your next vehicle, guaranteed and safe
auto_usate.INTRO_TEXT: La Dolce Vita Car Rental is a leading company in the sale of used cars, offering customers a careful selection of high-quality vehicles. Each car in our inventory undergoes rigorous checks and maintenance to ensure it meets the highest standards of safety and reliability. With a diverse range that includes sedans, SUVs, city cars, and luxury cars, we are committed to meeting the needs of all types of buyers.
auto_usate.ADVANTAGES_TEXT:
Transparency is one of the core values of the company: each vehicle comes with a complete and detailed history, including mileage, maintenance performed, and any previous accidents. This approach allows customers to buy with confidence, knowing exactly what they are purchasing.

La Dolce Vita Car Rental also offers flexible financing solutions, making the purchase of a used car accessible to a wide range of budgets.
auto_usate.CONSULTATION_TEXT:
The company's team of professionals is always available to provide personalized advice and help customers find the perfect vehicle for their needs.

With a constant commitment to customer satisfaction and a special focus on quality, La Dolce Vita Car Rental represents an excellent choice for anyone looking for a reliable and affordable used car.
auto_usate.SOCIAL_DESC: We publish new arrivals and special offers directly on our page. Join our community!

lavaggio.HERO_SUBTITLE: The attention to detail your car deserves
lavaggio.INTRO_TEXT: La Dolce Vita Car Rental is a leading company in the car rental sector and accurate vehicle cleaning services. Strategically located, it offers a wide range of vehicles to satisfy every need, from short-term rentals to long-term solutions. In addition to rental, La Dolce Vita is renowned for its car cleaning services, ensuring that every vehicle is always impeccable.
lavaggio.QUALITY_TITLE: Quality and Meticulous Care of the Interior
lavaggio.QUALITY_TEXT: The exterior cleaning service includes a thorough wash to remove dirt and debris, giving the bodywork a shine like new. Attention to detail continues with interior cleaning, where every corner of the passenger compartment is treated with care. Washing of carpets and seats is carried out using high-quality products to ensure the removal of stains and odors, restoring the original appearance and freshness of the car's interior.
lavaggio.CLEAN_TEXT: Thanks to advanced techniques and the use of specific detergents, La Dolce Vita is able to remove even the most stubborn stains, ensuring an impeccable result. The team of experienced professionals is dedicated to offering an excellent service, making every rental or cleaning experience a true pleasure for customers. Relying on La Dolce Vita Car Rental means choosing quality, care, and professionalism.
lavaggio.SOCIAL_DESC: Follow our page to see the results of our treatments and stay updated on promotions.

PRIVACY_POLICY.INTRO_TEXT:
La dolce vita S.r.l. - Personal Data Protection Information Notice
Before acquiring your personal data for viewing and using the La Dolce Vita Rent service, its platforms, and apps, La dolce vita S.r.l. invites you to carefully read this privacy notice, provided pursuant to Art. 13 of the European Regulation No. 679/2016 on the protection of personal data ("GDPR"), to allow you to understand how your personal information is handled when you use our services, to enable you, where necessary, to provide express and informed consent to the processing of your personal data, and to know (and if applicable) exercise your rights as a "Data Subject".
PRIVACY_POLICY.SEC1_DESC: In this section, we provide you with our contact references
PRIVACY_POLICY.SEC1_TD1: La dolce vita S.r.l., represented by the pro tempore Chief Executive Officer with registered office in Via S. Allende 1, 74017 Mottola-Italy, contactable at the email address ladolcevitarent@gmail.com
PRIVACY_POLICY.SEC2_DESC: In this section, we indicate what categories of data we request from you
PRIVACY_POLICY.SEC2_TD1_1: Data acquired directly from the data subject
PRIVACY_POLICY.SEC2_TD1_2: First and last name, email address, phone number, license plate or vehicle identifier, fiscal code, VAT number, residential address, place and date of birth, identification document (e.g., driver's license), driver's license data, payment data (credit cards), travel preferences, photograph.
PRIVACY_POLICY.SEC2_TD2_2: IP address, browser type, ISP, operating system and version, authentication logs (user ID, navigation), payment logs, finalization logs of navigation with booking or ticket issuance, modification logs, geolocation, driving style. App: Device ID, operating system and version.
PRIVACY_POLICY.SEC2_POST: The aforementioned data will be processed with IT and paper supports to guarantee appropriate security and confidentiality measures.
PRIVACY_POLICY.SEC3_TITLE: 3. Purposes and Legal Basis of Processing
PRIVACY_POLICY.SEC3_DESC: In this section, we indicate the purpose (and legal basis) of processing your personal data
PRIVACY_POLICY.SEC3_R1_C1: Compliance with obligations deriving from national or EU laws, for example regarding tax, accounting, administrative, and fiscal obligations, including the verification of the driver's license, also processed through interconnection with the Civil Motorization database. Your personal data may also be processed to comply with requests from competent administrative or judicial authorities, for example regarding the identification and subsequent notification to the offender of administrative monetary fines under the Highway Code, or investigations related to road accidents.
PRIVACY_POLICY.SEC3_R1_C2: Legal obligation to which the data controller is subject
PRIVACY_POLICY.SEC3_R2_C1: Execution of the provisions of the General Conditions of Contract, Regulations, and the provision of ancillary and/or connected services. For this purpose, data relating to the registration of your profile on the site and/or App will also be processed, including collection, storage, and processing aimed at the operational, technical, and administrative management of the relationship, as well as data relating to payments (including penalties, fines, and other ancillary charges), including your credit card data (or other payment instrument), and data relating to the geolocation of your mobile device, within the limits of what is strictly necessary for opening the vehicle, using the service, and detecting contractual violations. Your data may also be processed, in the pre-contractual phase, to comply with your specific requests.
PRIVACY_POLICY.SEC3_R2_C2: Processing necessary for the performance of a contract to which the data subject is party or for the performance of pre-contractual measures taken at the data subject's request
PRIVACY_POLICY.SEC3_R3_C1: Adoption of measures aimed at protection against credit risk, including activities aimed at your correct identification, and the assessment of your economic reliability and/or solvency.
PRIVACY_POLICY.SEC3_R4_C1: Analysis of the use of the services consumed, in order to improve them, or to meet specific controller needs.
PRIVACY_POLICY.SEC3_R5_C1: Provision of a geolocation system on the vehicles used, and any other measures to protect them, in order to prevent and/or suppress any unlawful and/or fraudulent acts.
PRIVACY_POLICY.SEC3_R6_C1: Processing necessary for introductory activities and consequences to merger, sale, or transfer of a business branch operations.
PRIVACY_POLICY.SEC3_R7_C1: Marketing of LA DOLCE VITA S.R.L. services and/or sending advertising/informative/promotional material and participation in prize initiatives and offers.
PRIVACY_POLICY.SEC3_R8_C1: Surveys on the level of satisfaction with the quality of services offered, via telephone, email, or other survey systems.
PRIVACY_POLICY.SEC3_POST: The provision of data necessary for pursuing the purposes referred to in the previous points is 'mandatory' and any refusal could make it impossible for LA DOLCE VITA S.R.L. to allow and guarantee you to be uniquely recognized during access, to navigate the application, to perform route searches, to issue the travel ticket and/or service, and to issue the related invoice. The provision of data for commercial purposes is optional and subject to your express consent.
PRIVACY_POLICY.SEC4_DESC: In this section, we indicate who will process your data and to whom it will be communicated. For the pursuit of the aforementioned purposes, personal data will be processed by the following subjects:
PRIVACY_POLICY.SEC4_TH1: Subjects attributable to LA DOLCE VITA S.R.L.
PRIVACY_POLICY.SEC4_TH2: Subjects not directly attributable to LA DOLCE VITA S.R.L.
PRIVACY_POLICY.SEC4_R1_C2: Public safety authorities, insurance companies competent for the management and settlement of claims; debt collection companies and companies specialized in the management of commercial or credit information;
PRIVACY_POLICY.SEC4_POST: Your data will only be processed by employees and representatives of the Controller, who are adequately instructed and trained, or by other entities acting as Data Processors. The data subject to processing will never be disseminated.
PRIVACY_POLICY.SEC5_DESC: In this section, we indicate how long we will keep your data. The personal data you provided will be kept for a period of time no longer than necessary to satisfy the purposes for which they were collected.
PRIVACY_POLICY.SEC5_R1_C2: For a period of ten years starting from: 1) The termination of the contractual relationship; 2) the last mandatory act interrupting the statute of limitations of rights; 3) the twenty-fourth month from the last access, in case of non-use.
PRIVACY_POLICY.SEC5_R2_C2: Until consent is revoked or after 24 months from account deletion.
PRIVACY_POLICY.SEC5_POST: Personal data, once anonymized, may be used and reused without limitation in consideration of the loss of its personal data quality.
PRIVACY_POLICY.SEC6_TITLE: 6. Data Transfer Outside the European Union and Automated Decision-Making Process
PRIVACY_POLICY.SEC6_TEXT: Your personal data may be transferred outside the EU. Should such transfer occur, the Controller will adopt all appropriate measures to ensure an adequate level of protection, in compliance with an adequacy decision, or upon signing Standard Contractual Clauses. Your personal data will not be subjected to any automated decision-making process.
PRIVACY_POLICY.SEC7_TEXT:
The EU Regulation 2016/679 (Articles 15 to 23) grants data subjects the exercise of specific rights. In particular, you have the right to request access, rectification, erasure, restriction, and objection from LA DOLCE VITA S.R.L. The data subject has the right to request the portability of their personal data. If you have provided your consent, you can revoke it at any time.

You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the Supervisory Authority (Garante per la Protezione dei Dati Personali). At any time, you can ask to exercise your rights by contacting ladolcevitarent@gmail.com or the DPO at basilestudio94@gmail.com.
PRIVACY_POLICY.SEC8_TEXT: This Privacy Policy may require periodic updates. LA DOLCE VITA S.R.L. reserves the right to modify or integrate it at any time. You will be informed of any changes through the website or app, or also via email.
